messages:
drew_sales: Lumen POC update: Node client intermittently fails to assemble SSE events. JSON.parse error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input'.

lumen_poc_contact: Hosted (eu-west). Occurs ~1/min after a few KB. No X-Request-Id seen. Also observed occasional 429s right before disconnects.

ina_engineer: Which EventSource library? Can you paste a tiny curl capture and any proxy logs?

lumen_poc_contact: Using EventSource polyfill in Node. Minimal curl we ran:

```
curl -v -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/stream-xyz"
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
{ [partial chunk]
```

Sometimes a chunk ends mid-JSON, e.g. `data:{"text":"...incomplete` then connection closes. Client throws on parse.

sam_infra: Proxy log shows `upstream_write() returned 0` followed by `502 while reading upstream` at the same timestamps. That usually means the upstream closed abruptly or the proxy reset the TCP stream. Quick infra mitigations: disable proxy_buffering for the SSE route and increase proxy_read_timeout/send_timeout for this org; ensure X-Accel-Buffering is off. Also consider opt-in shorter heartbeat (15s) from runtime.

leo_support: Client-side recommendations: buffer until the full SSE event terminator (an empty line) before running JSON.parse, handle partial UTF-8 across chunks, and implement exponential backoff on abrupt close or 429. We'll send a snippet.

ina_engineer: I'll push a canary change to turn off buffering and bump timeouts for the lumen org in eu-west. Sam, can you apply?

sam_infra: Canary applied for lumen org (eu-west): `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 180s; send_timeout 180s;`. Please retest and provide a 5-minute repro window if you still see failures.

lumen_poc_contact: Immediate retest: 0/12 failures (was ~3/12). We'll run a 2h soak and report back. Thanks!

opsbot: Ticket SF-7777 created to track: add X-Request-Id on SSE responses and optional 15s heartbeat. Linked to lumen POC.
